quick_ref.Theme: The Hero Academy — Show Your Powers!

methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Action & Ability Linking
content: Problem: Students often forget to drop the "to" after "can" (e.g., saying "I can to play").

Solution: This week anchors the modal "can" and "can't" directly to bare infinitive action verbs. By chanting and acting out the chunks ("can sing", "can't fly"), students internalize the pattern naturally. TPR (Total Physical Response) is heavily used to demonstrate abilities.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show an action flashcard (e.g., sing). Student must make an affirmative sentence: "I can sing."
S2 pull-out: Show an action flashcard. Student must make a negative sentence: "I can't swim."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A knows what Max can do. Student B knows what Luna can do. They ask and answer to fill the talent show roster.

content: It's the Hero Academy Talent Show!
"I can sing!" says Luna. She sings a beautiful song.
"I can dance!" says Tom. He dances very well.

T / F: Max can jump high.
What can Max do very fast?

content: It's the Hero Academy Talent Show!

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W12: can, can't, sing, dance, run
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (can, can't, sing, dance, run) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Can / Can't (Ability)
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Can / Can't (Ability).
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Community & Routines — The Talent Show"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Community & Routines — The Talent Show".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (can, can't, sing, dance, run usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.

chanting.title: Chanting — W12 (10 prompts)

listening_script.text: Max is at the talent show. He can run very fast. He can jump over a box. Max can sing and dance. He is very happy.
dictation: He can run fast." "Max can sing.

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 1 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: Ask a question ("Can you sing?").
  Student B: Answer with ability ("Yes, I can sing!").

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ (can / is / on) run fast.
  She can _______________ (jump / book / desk) high.
  We can _______________ (sing / water / apple) a song.
  He can _______________ (dance / tall / red) well.
  They _______________ (can / have / are) run in the park.
  I can _______________ (jump / eat / sky) over the box.
  Luna can _______________ (dance / bus / car).
  Max can _______________ (sing / building / tree).
  I can run and _______________ (jump / dog / cat).
  The boy can _______________ (run / table / chair) fast.
  L4 — Sentence Expansion (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] name [2] Talent [3] things [4] run [5] jump [6] sing [7] dance [8] happy [9] What [10] run [11] show [12] today [13] goodbye

listening_script.text: Luna can swim in the water. She can climb a tall tree. But she can't fly. She can't ride a bike yet. She can learn new things!

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 2 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: State what you can do ("I can swim").
  Student B: State what you can't do ("But I can't fly").

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ (can't / am / is) fly.
  She can _______________ (climb / book / table) a tree.
  We can _______________ (swim / sky / red) in the water.
  He can't _______________ (ride / bed / house) a bike.
  They can _______________ (draw / water / food) a picture.
  I _______________ (can't / are / have) sing well.
  Luna can _______________ (climb / bus / train) up high.
  Max can _______________ (swim / building / desk) fast.
  I can ride a _______________ (bike / dog / cat).
  The girl can _______________ (draw / table / chair) a dog.
  L4 — Sentence Expansion (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] I am Luna [2] about my powers [3] in the water [4] climb a tall tree [5] ride a bike yet [6] is very fun

listening_script.text: Tom is on the stage. He can draw beautiful pictures. He can ride a bike fast. But he can't sing. Everyone is a great team.
dictation: He can draw pictures." "He can ride a bike.

teacher_contents.in_class_speaking:
IN-CLASS SPEAKING ACTIVITIES — Session 3 (teacher-led)

Activity 1 — Pair Speaking (3–5 min, pairs):
  Student A: Ask "What can you do?"
  Student B: Answer "I can [action 1], but I can't [action 2]."

Challenge Extension (L3 — for advanced / older students):
  [O] L3 — Older: Fill in the blank with 3 options (10 items)
  I _______________ (can / is / are) ride a bike.
  She _______________ (can't / not / am) swim in the water.
  We can _______________ (draw / book / desk) a picture.
  He can _______________ (climb / red / tall) a tree.
  They can't _______________ (sing / sky / blue).
  I can _______________ (dance / bed / sleep) to the music.
  Luna can _______________ (run / fast / high).
  Max can't _______________ (jump / tall / short).
  I can ride a _______________ (bike / fish / water).
  The hero can _______________ (draw / table / chair) well.
  L4 — Sentence Expansion (Mixed Review) (10 items)
teacher_contents.vc_answer_key: [1] Welcome to the great [2] has special powers here [3] run fast and jump [4] draw beautiful pictures of [5] ride a bike very [6] we are a great [7] do many things together
